data.body: CI RCA for Change 1847 PS1 (run 32098530041): deterministic test-failure, not infrastructure. All Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 shards failed the repo-root isolation guard on the same newly-created `.pytest_cache`, attributed to different concurrent tests only because xdist observed the shared leak asynchronously. The patchset adds `test_failure_rendering_does_not_expose_ambient_environment`, whose nested `python -m pytest` runs with `cwd=_REPO` and does not pass `-p no:cacheprovider`; unlike the outer CI suite, the child therefore enables pytest cache and creates `_REPO/.pytest_cache` mid-run. Local discriminating reproduction on the patchset: with `.pytest_cache` absent, `pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 4 tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_env_repr_security.py` returns one passed + one teardown error naming exactly `[`.pytest_cache`]`. This rules out the production fixture env narrowing and Python-version behavior; the defect is the new nested-test invocation failing to sandbox/disable its own cache. Fix must keep nested pytest artifacts outside REPO_ROOT (or disable cache) while preserving the environment-redaction oracle. No repush until the currently pending CI runs complete, per one-pending-run discipline.
